content_sections.heading: THSTI Data Manager Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for THSTI Data Manager Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Data Manager position?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. The walk-in interview is scheduled for 08 September 2026. Candidates should report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Data Manager role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Masters' degree with 6 years of experience or a Graduation degree with 8 years of experience in relevant fields like clinical data management, research, or IT.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Data Manager position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Data Manager position is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Data Manager post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 56,000/- per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Data Manager post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Data Manager post. However, the total number of vacancies mentioned in the brief is 6.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview for THSTI Data Manager recruitment being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at THSTI, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway, Faridabad – 121001, Haryana.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for the Data Manager position?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Data Manager role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a written test, skill test, and/or interview, as decided by the institute.
